'''Nevo Faunor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who worked with his brother, [[Irol Faunor]] on many jobs, with their loyal grunts that were paid well. Even though he and his brother were experienced in their work they had to retreat when attmepting to capture a scientist named [[Min Erethen]], because there were [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] protecting her. Nevo was armed with a [[DL-12 heavy blaster pistol]] and a [[Duelist vibrorapier]], which he used more often. He usually wore a [[combat jumpsuit]].
